disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction of locked-period actuals is merged with comparatives loading into a single automated data-consolidation step, since both are mechanical data-sourcing activities that can run on the same pipeline without loss of control; the locked-period actuals input is preserved per VAR-R-01.

Loading of the approved budget version and latest forecast is merged into the same automated extraction/consolidation step as VAR-01, preserving both required comparative inputs per VAR-R-02 while removing a redundant manual handoff.

Variance computation is retained unchanged in substance: it still consumes the accounting policies applied to actuals (VAR-R-05, KB-06 policy consistency) and constant-currency exchange rates (VAR-R-06, KB-07 FX translation) so that price/volume/mix variances remain computed on a consistent basis with FX isolated.

Application of materiality thresholds is preserved as a distinct step (VAR-R-08) consuming both the percentage and absolute thresholds (VAR-R-03), and remains performed by the FP&A analyst, a different actor from the manager who performs review in TGT-06, satisfying the required actor separation (VAR-R-04).
Unconstrained by design; commentary from accountable budget holders is retained as-is since human judgment on root causes cannot be mechanized and no requirement calls for its redesign.
Unconstrained by design; consolidation of variances and commentary into a draft report is retained unchanged as a straightforward aggregation step feeding the mandatory review stage.

Review and challenge survives as a required control (VAR-R-07), performed by the FP&A manager, distinct from the FP&A analyst who performs materiality selection in TGT-03, thereby satisfying the actor-separation requirement (VAR-R-04).
Unconstrained by design; presentation and distribution to management is retained unchanged as the terminal reporting step with no bearing requirement altering it.

steps.description: An automated data pipeline, overseen by the FP&A analyst, extracts actuals from the locked, closed period and loads the approved budget version and latest forecast as comparatives into a single reconciled dataset, eliminating duplicate manual pulls and ensuring both sides of the comparison are sourced at the same cutoff.
steps.name: Automated extraction and consolidation of actuals and comparatives

steps.description: Price, volume and mix variances are computed on actuals and budget prepared on the same accounting basis, with the FX effect isolated at constant currency.
steps.name: Compute price, volume and mix variances

steps.description: Variances exceeding either the percentage or the absolute threshold are selected for explanation. Retained as a distinct, auditable gating step so that the selection logic and its criteria remain inspectable and separately accountable from downstream review.
steps.name: Apply materiality thresholds and select variances for explanation

steps.description: Accountable budget holders provide commentary on the selected variances.
steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders

steps.description: Variances and commentary are consolidated into a draft variance report.
steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report

steps.description: The draft report and its commentary are reviewed and challenged by a manager who did not perform the materiality selection, preserving segregation of duties between selection and review.
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.description: The reviewed report is presented and distributed to management.
steps.name: Present and distribute to management
